title: WhatIf-Bench: Benchmarking Intervention-Aware Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.26582v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent time series foundation models (TSFMs) can consume covariates in-context, extending zero-shot forecasting to problems driven by external factors. This enables scenario analysis: forecasting how a target responds to events that set covariates to chosen future values. Whether they can do this reliably is an open question. We introduce WhatIf-Bench, a benchmark measuring how well forecasters use covariates to forecast a target's response to future events. WhatIf-Bench is semi-synthetic: time series come from mechanistic simulators of data centers, power grids, road traffic, and water networks, with controlled covariate-target relationships grounded in each system. Each task presents a history of events intervening on covariates, then asks to forecast a future event that either replays seen values (Replay) or sets them to unseen ones (Novel). Varying the number of covariates, historical events, and event length yields 37,665

translated_title: WhatIf-Bench：面向干预感知时间序列预测的基准测试
translated_abstract: 近年来，时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）可以在上下文中接收协变量，将零样本预测扩展到由外部因素驱动的问题上。这使得情景分析成为可能：即预测目标变量对那些将协变量设定为特定未来值的事件的响应。然而，这些模型能否可靠地做到这一点仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们提出了WhatIf-Bench，这是一个用于衡量预测模型利用协变量来预测目标对未来事件响应能力的基准。WhatIf-Bench是半合成的：时间序列来自数据中心、电网、道路交通和供水网络的机理仿真器，其协变量与目标之间的关系在每个系统中受到控制且具有实际依据。每个任务都呈现一段对协变量进行干预的事件历史，然后要求模型预测一个未来事件，该事件要么重放已见过的协变量值（Replay），要么将其设定为未见过的值（Novel）。通过改变协变量数量、历史事件数量和事件长度，共产生了37,665个任务。
tldr: 该论文提出了WhatIf-Bench，一个基于数据中心、电网、交通和供水系统机理仿真器构建的半合成基准，用于系统评估时间序列基础模型利用协变量进行干预感知情景预测的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces WhatIf-Bench, a semi-synthetic benchmark built on mechanistic simulators of real-world systems (data centers, power grids, traffic, and water networks) to systematically evaluate how well time series foundation models leverage covariates for intervention-aware scenario forecasting.
